name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Survive the Night
source:
Five Nights at Freddy's: Survive The Night - The Visual Novel is a fan game which takes place three years after Five Nights at Freddy's 2, by Scott Cawthon, available on Steam. The game is developed in Visual Novelty 0.8.9.

YOU IN THE FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S WORLD: Play as your own character, boy or girl, in Survive the Night - The Visual Novel.

CLASSIC AND NEW: The Toys and Withered Animatronics are back, and their only mission for the whole night is to kill you as fast as they can.

NEW CHARACTERS: Talk with new characters, like your new partner Stryker or the Sergeant Ryan, created exclusively for Five Nights at Freddy's: Survive the Night.

IT'S YOUR CHOICE: You make your own dialogue choices and your own action choices in Five Nights at Freddy's: Survive the Night. Be careful with what you choice, some of them might affect the ending...

DESTINY: After all, will you Survive the Night?

[From [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/five-nights-at-freddy-s-survive-the-night-the-visual-novel/155371]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
《玩具熊的五夜后宫：熬过长夜》视觉小说版是一款同人游戏，故事发生在斯科特·考顿制作、于Steam发售的《玩具熊的五夜后宫2》三年后。本作使用Visual Novelty 0.8.9开发。

走进《玩具熊的五夜后宫》的世界：在《熬过长夜》视觉小说版中，扮演属于你自己的角色，可以是男生，也可以是女生。

经典与新面孔：玩具系列与破损系列机械玩偶再次登场。整整一夜，它们唯一的任务就是尽快杀死你。

全新角色：与新角色交谈，比如新搭档斯特赖克，或瑞安警长。他们都是为《玩具熊的五夜后宫：熬过长夜》专门创作的角色。

由你选择：在《玩具熊的五夜后宫：熬过长夜》中，你将自行选择对话与行动。请谨慎选择，有些决定可能影响结局……

命运：最终，你能熬过这漫长的一夜吗？

（来源：[url=http://gamejolt.com/games/five-nights-at-freddy-s-survive-the-night-the-visual-novel/155371]GameJolt[/url]）
